info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Cilantro Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Cilantro Jacket Detail Management API enables the creation of detailed catalog entries for the Cilantro Jacket product. This API is designed for retail and inventory systems, providing capabilities to populate essential product information to enhance customer listings and inventory accuracy. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that seek to improve product visibility and detail. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure that their catalog reflects up-to-date and relevant information about the Cilantro Jacket, driving informed purchasing decisions.

post.summary: Create details for a cilantro jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store details related to a cilantro jacket, facilitating effective inventory management and customer preferences tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the cilantro jacket. It expects a JSON object that conforms to the specified schema, allowing for the inclusion of all necessary information related to the jacket's features and specifications.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the detailed information.

quantity.description: The quantity of cilantro jackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the cilantro jacket.
